metadata.question: Does the area around (43.244129, -79.198692) apprear greener than (43.263113, -79.069485) in Lake Ontario on February 4, 2021?

data.raw_code: The question asks to compare greenness between two locations in Lake Ontario on February 4, 2021. This requires: 1. Using NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) as a measure of greenness 2. Comparing two points: (43.244129, -79.198692) and (43.263113, -79.069485) 3. Date: February 4, 2021 4. Since it's winter in Canada, vegetation will likely be dormant, but we need to compare relative greenness Strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 imagery for good spatial resolution - Calculate NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) - Extract NDVI values at both points - Compare the values Data quality considerations: - February in Canada likely has snow/cloud cover - Need to check for valid pixels after cloud masking - May need to use a small date window around Feb 4, 2021 if no clear image exists ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define points and date const point1 = ee.Geometry.Point([-79.198692, 43.244129]); const point2 = ee.Geometry.Point([-79.069485, 43.263113]); const date = '2021-02-04'; // 2. Get Sentinel-2 imagery let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterDate('2021-02-01', '2021-02-07') // 3-day window for cloud-free chance .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.Point([-79.134088, 43.253621])) // Center between points .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)); // Check if collection is empty const count = collection.size().getInfo(); if (count === 0) { print("No suitable Sentinel-2 images found"); print("C1"); return; } // Get least cloudy image const image = collection.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // 3. Calculate NDVI const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); // 4. Extract NDVI values at points const ndvi1 = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point1.buffer(100), // 100m buffer for stability scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const ndvi2 = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point2.buffer(100), scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); // 5. Get pixel counts to validate data const count1 = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point1.buffer(100), scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const count2 = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point2.buffer(100), scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); // 6. Retrieve values const [val1, val2, cnt1, cnt2] = await Promise.all([ ndvi1.getInfo(), ndvi2.getInfo(), count1.getInfo(), count2.getInfo() ]); print(`Point 1 NDVI: ${val1 !== null ? val1.toFixed(3) : 'No data'}, Pixels: ${cnt1}`); print(`Point 2 NDVI: ${val2 !== null ? val2.toFixed(3) : 'No data'}, Pixels: ${cnt2}`); print(`Images found: ${count}`); // 7. Validate and determine answer if (val1 === null || val2 === null || cnt1 === 0 || cnt2 === 0) { print("C2"); } else if (isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2) || val1 > 1 || val2 > 1 || val1 < -1 || val2 < -1) { print("C3"); } else if (val1 > val2) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
